verdict.detail: Badge dark rifle matches ref within 10% (1798 px ours against 1813 px ref).

overlap.rule: One pixel holds one colour, so the badge and ink masks never share a pixel. The winner is one per shared box, by pixel count inside that box.

corner_120px.note: When the boxes do not overlap, the corner box around the badge top-right corner is the reported substitute.

shadow.reason: A negative drop means the ring just outside the ink is brighter than the band 3 to 12 px out. The dark map behind the text hides any shadow, so this test cannot prove a shadow is present or absent.
shadow.headroom_note: Headroom is the band mean luma: how bright the background is. A dark band leaves no room for a shadow darker than the map to show.

badge.measure: badge_parts: dark is luma under 80 (rifle), bright is luma over 200 (RSF text). Dark non-orange is RGB distance from RSF (204, 71, 38) over 12 and luma under 95, one stated measure for both sides.
badge.rifle_source_note: The rifle.png source file count is a ceiling only, not the ref value.

trace_dot.halo: faint soft glow, luminance 87 at 8px out vs Sudan background 47, extends about 15px
trace_dot.note: Small soft white dot, no hard white core above luminance 150 on its left side. Sits just above the RSF badge's top-right corner (badge corner at screenshot (802,554)). No ring or circle around it in any frame.

dot.merge_rule: A merge is flagged when the found component is larger than the scene dot box (11 by 11, 121 px).

halo.note: Halo is dimensions.radial_profile at the anchor centre. When the dot merged, the anchor is the scene dot centre.

ink.window: x dot-10 to dot+220, y dot-25 to dot+25 around the anchor centre. Ink is luma 180 or higher.
ink.exclusion: The halo disc (radius from the scene halo box) and the dot disc (radius from the scene dot box) are excluded around the anchor centre.

corrections.fix: Shrink halo-fasher and lower its opacity. Our halo glow spills past its scene box into the label window: label ink after excluding the halo disc is 1958 px against 449 px in ref, and corner ink is 784 px against 145 px in ref.

context.meaning: At frame 168 (7 s) the rifle renders: badge dark is 1798 px against 1813 px in ref. Layering still differs where corrections are listed.
correction_rules: Ours badge dark under 90% of ref badge dark: restore rifle-rsf on the badge box.
Ours halo falloff over ref falloff + 20, or ours ink after exclusion over 1.5x ref ink, or ours corner ink over 2x ref corner ink: shrink halo-fasher and lower its opacity.
Overlap winners differ between sides while the boxes overlap: raise label-fasher z above the badge.
A negative shadow drop never makes a correction: the test cannot separate a shadow from the dark map.

limits: One frame pair per call. A sampled sweep runs the command once per frame (every 12th frame, 0 to 180).
One pixel holds one colour, so the badge and ink masks never share a pixel. The overlap winner is per shared box, not per pixel.
The shadow test cannot prove a shadow is present or absent: a negative drop means no dark fringe is detectable, and the dark map hides any shadow.
The dark non-orange luma threshold (95) was settled by measuring the fresh post-fix render, where it puts the ours count near the fixer count 2,668.
The rifle.png source count is a ceiling only, not the ref value.
Badge dark at luma under 80 catches only the darkest rifle core. Mid brown rifle pixels sit above 80 and are not counted.
The dot merge flag fires when the found component is larger than the scene dot box. When it fires, the halo and label window anchor to the scene dot centre.
This report measures one frame pair. It does not record which render profile made the ours frame.
